title: Young Dryads
hook: Player-safe note: Small sapling spirits with bark-textured limbs, leaf hair, green-gold eyes, and shy defensive postures rooted around stones like children guarding a boundary.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Childlike sapling spirits with bark limbs, leaf hair, glowing green-gold eyes, shy defensive posture, roots around stones, spring leaves, and moss.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Children of the wood with bark for skin, shy until a kindness is broken. They guard the stones like a held breath, and they only turn fierce when a guest takes the welcome they were given and spits on it.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Axes and fire, the Hunting Trees that were once kin gone wrong, and guests who smile and then steal.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
